blocks.x: Now I've got a list of these rooms, I've got a list of these musicians and I'll really ask both of you to interject a name at anytime where I don't have it so this is the end of Side One of Tape Two at the Afterhours with the interview of Baby Lovett, the great Samuel Baby Lovett, with Crook Goodwin and yours truly, Art Smith. We'll be right back with Side Two of Tape Two.

Side Two of Tape Two of the interview with Samuel Baby Lovett, the nationally known and famous Kansas City jazz drummer, with Crook Goodwin, the great guitarist and vocalist, who's helped himself to make so much of Kansas City jazz history, who is currently with Art Smith's Kansas City Jazz Band. This is yours truly, Art Smith.
